Body_length data

Source: R/doc-Body_length.R
Body_length.Rd

Simulated body lengths of beetles reared in containers within populations, under two treatments in two habitats, of the kind used by Nakagawa and Schielzeth (2013) to illustrate \(R^2\) for mixed models. Used in the R2_glmm vignette.

Usage

data(Body_length)

Format

A data frame with 960 rows and 6 columns:

Population

factor, 12 populations.

Container

factor, 120 containers (nested in populations).

Sex

factor, Female or Male.

Habitat

factor, A or B.

Treatment

factor, Cont or Exp.

BodyL

numeric, body length.

References

Nakagawa, S. and Schielzeth, H. (2013), A general and simple method for obtaining \(R^2\) from generalized linear mixed-effects models. Methods in Ecology and Evolution, 4, 133–142.

Examples

data(Body_length)
fm <- lmer(BodyL ~ Treatment + Habitat + Sex + (1|Population/Container), data = Body_length)
R2_glmm(fm)
#> # Adjusted R2 for Mixed Models
#>                Total                Fixed               Random 
#>             "73.39%"             "40.09%"              "33.3%" 
#> Container:Population           Population 
#>              "5.18%"             "28.13%"
